title: Your Trip, in Your Pocket
subtitle: Every useful detail. Beautifully within reach.

storyboard.scene: A tangible midnight-blue phone rises into view. The itinerary unfolds as a gently travelling route links three useful moments.
The itinerary becomes a document wallet. Original boarding-pass and hotel-voucher cards slide forward; a travelling highlight draws attention to the selected card.
A useful coach update arrives as a floating notification and expands into a readable meeting-point card.
The screen becomes a four-image album of completely original vector travel illustrations. Tiles appear and gather into one shared memory collection.
Shared Global Connect Travels brand end card.
